discovered_urls.context: The academic paper this repository reproduces: 'Computational Life: How Well-formed, Self-replicating Programs Emerge from Simple Interaction'
discovered_urls.relevance_hint: Research paper on emergent self-replication from simple program interactions. Relevant to understanding emergent behavior in multi-agent systems at a theoretical level. Likely low practical relevance (3-4/10) but could inform thinking about evolutionary agent selection.
